title: C4 golden expected screen
description: The expected-screen shape of the C4 golden fixtures (golden-alt-screen, golden-wide-chars, golden-resize-mid-stream, golden-reflow, golden-sgr, golden-input-modes, golden-mode-reset). **This is fixture-only: it is never on any wire.** No C4 message, and no client message anywhere, carries a structured cell or row API (R8; F19: the prefix/dump is the only cell-bearing form a client sees). A golden fixture feeds output bytes (and, F14d, resize events) through a fresh parser and asserts that the screen it then shows equals this document: rows per screen, the cursor, the active screen, the set modes and, where a case needs them, SGR runs. It encodes a screen as a test oracle, never as an API. Rows are plain text with trailing blanks trimmed; SGR runs are the styling a case cares about, addressed by row and column, and absent when the case does not test styling.

cols.description: The terminal width the screen was parsed at.

rows.description: The terminal height the screen was parsed at.

active_screen.description: Which screen is active when the parser reaches the expected state (the one CSI ?1049h/l switches between).

sgr_runs.description: Optional: the styling a case tests, each run addressed by screen, row and column. Absent when the case does not test styling.

primary.description: The primary screen's lines. Always present.

alt.description: The alternate screen's lines, present when the case has entered it.

screens.description: Both screens a case asserts, ordered as the dump emits them (primary first, then alt).

lines.description: One string per visible row, top to bottom; trailing blanks trimmed. A wide glyph occupies its cell once and its continuation is not repeated.

style.description: The cursor's style, present only when the engine exposes it (C4 decision 6, D20).

kitty_keyboard.description: Kitty keyboard flags, present only when the engine exposes them (F14).

modify_other_keys.description: modifyOtherKeys level, present only when the engine exposes it (F14).

modes.description: The carried input modes the dump must set as their full state (C4 decision 6). Only the modes a case asserts are given values; each field here is the mode's state, never a default.

mode.description: The mouse tracking mode as set, never substituted.

encoding.description: The mouse encoding as set (CSI ?1005/1006/1015), never substituted; x10 is the encoding with no ?1005/1006/1015 set.

sgr.description: The SGR parameters the run carries, semicolon-separated, without the leading CSI or the trailing m.

sgr_run.description: One styled run a case asserts, addressed by screen, row and column.
